requested_author_decisions.proposal: 64-byte explicit big-endian body with signed opaque scenario/source/authority/key IDs, 64-bit epoch/logical-time/sequence, domain separator S7E-AERC-AUTH-V1, and no topology/fault labels.
Keep all private test keys outside cFS FSW in a deterministic local host-side signing harness; producer/qualifier/verifier/decision/sink FSW remain private-key-free.
Represent authority separation with signed opaque authority_id plus research-only harness provenance/state; do not add a second authority-signature hierarchy.

Structural-only completeness; authorization claim preserved independently for structurally complete evidence; controlled logical time; exact duplicates idempotent; valid rollback/equivocation drives path-local noncontradictory=0; invalid signatures do not advance authenticated sequence state.
Use the current draft F0-F12 stage transforms, including F9 post-signature XOR of epoch LSB at byte 47 and F12 separately signed same-sequence opposite-authorization equivocation.
